comparison.objective: Mount an emergency-stop button through a keyed panel opening and secure it with a rear locking ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient a tab to a notch, insert through a panel, support from the front, and thread a rear ring.
comparison.success_condition: Button tab seated in the notch and locking ring fully engaged with the assembly retained in the panel.
comparison.reason: Keyed insertion and rear-ring assembly differ from adjustment of an installed damper. The candidate's screw only locks a selected collar setting and success depends on measured dynamic stopping performance.
